question.text: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) exercises supervision over three professional bodies under separate Acts of Parliament. Which institute is the Social Reporting Organization (SRO) for Social Impact Assessors under the XXIII framework?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) — SRO for SIAs
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) — SRO for SIAs
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) — through its SIAB, it serves as the notified SRO; ICMAI and ICSI have parallel social-audit bodies but the SIA empanelment is via ICAI SIAB
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) acts as the SRO via its Financial Inclusion wing

explanation.text: **The Logic:** ICAI's Sustainability Reporting Standards Board / Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) serves as the empanelling body for SIAs. ICMAI has the ICMAI Social Auditors Organization (ICMAI SAO), and ICSI has its ISA, but for the NISM XXIII framework, ICAI SIAB is the reference SRO for SIAs. **The Trap:** Option A swaps ICMAI for ICAI — a classic trap. Option B swaps ICSI. Option D places RBI in an incorrect role. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cross-links to Ch 5 (SIA Assessors) and Ch 11 (Key Regulations). A common misread is treating ICMAI or ICSI bodies as equivalent to ICAI SIAB. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Confirm your SIA empanelment is with ICAI SIAB (for CA route), ICMAI SAO (for CMA route) or ICSI ISA (for CS route). Your URN (Unique Reference Number) engagement plans will differ based on the SRO. Always cite the correct SRO in your assurance statement.
